name: database-performance-observatory
description: Root package for managing DPO stack

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../seeder && npm install
scripts.start: npm run dbs:up && echo '⏳ Waiting 15 seconds for databases to initialize...' && sleep 15 && npm run dbs:seed && npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "green,blue" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
